steps.note: inserts the highlighted skill as a chip: label = display name, link label = $name
sends: the prompt is the composer's markdown (prompt-history atom); route1 refuses the turn, so the original keeps the text and shows the error toast

recorder.stack: tools/route1/linux/start.sh copy on port 4620 (fake ssh runs the mock app-server with a fuzzyFileSearch session over hello.py, README.md, src/math.py, src/matrix.rs, docs/notes.md; server.mjs READ_ONLY patched to pass fuzzyFileSearch/*), fleet chrome tier :9522, own incognito context per run, CODEX_HOME /sdc-disk/tmp/cgx/s020/inv-r1/home
notes: Two runs on separate pages (steps, second.steps): a third `@` search in one page trips a renderer bug in the Pages search.
The list sets aria-current on the highlighted row; aria-activedescendant stays unset.
Plugins rows (Browser, Computer, Pets) come from host services the port does not have; the port's rows must appear in the recorded order.

A chip is a contenteditable=false span: 16 px icon in a 19 px slot, then the label (file name, or the skill's display name) in font-weight 500, color-mix(text-info 80%, text 20%); a space follows the chip.

The prompt sent replaces a file chip by [name](path) and a skill chip by [$name](skill path); result.prompt is the prompt-history markdown of the send (getText and getPersistedText share the markdown serializer).
